high.title: Junior Software Engineer (SDE I)
high.description:
Software Engineer / Full-Stack Developer (SDE I — Freshers & Early Career) — Discorder.tools


Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)
Department: Engineering & Product

About the Role
discorder.tools is a fast-growing utility platform built for millions of Discord users, creators, moderators, and developers worldwide, offering instant browser-based tools like ID lookups, snowflake decoders, timestamp generators, and AI-driven community utilities. We are looking for energetic, driven, and quick-learning Software Engineers (SDE I) to join our product team. If you love building slick, high-performance web applications, micro-utilities, and tools that scale rapidly, this is your launchpad. 


Freshers with strong project portfolios and engineers with 0 to 2 years of experience are strongly encouraged to apply!

What You Will Do

- Build fast, responsive, and intuitive user interfaces and browser-based tools using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
- Develop backend lookup services, API integrations, and fast utility processing scripts using Python or Node.js.
- Work directly with web APIs, performance optimization, and clean client-side state management.
- Collaborate with product teams to ship new community utilities, bot helper tools, and AI-powered text features.
- Write clean code, handle feedback rapidly, and help scale our platform infrastructure as traffic spikes.

What We Are Looking For

- 0 to 2 years of software development experience (internships, personal projects, or full-time roles).
- Solid foundation in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python/Node.js, and core computer science fundamentals.
- Familiarity or hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks (React / Next.js).
- High energy, a "get things done" startup mindset, and an eye for clean, minimalist user interfaces.
- Ability to work from our Bengaluru office in a collaborative, fast-paced team environment.

Tech Stack You Will Use

- Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Python / Node.js, REST APIs
- Tools & Infrastructure: Git, GitHub, Vercel / Cloud Hosting

Compensation & Perks

- Base Salary Range: ₹10,00,000 – ₹18,00,000 per annum (based on capability and project portfolio).
- Perks: Direct mentorship from senior engineers, rapid career growth in a high-traffic product startup, and flexible hybrid work culture in Bengaluru.

medium.title: Full Stack Developer – Node.js, React, TypeScript & AI-Assisted Development
medium.description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking a Full Stack Developer with strong hands-on expertise in Node.js, React, TypeScript, SQL, and NoSQL databases. The role involves designing, developing, testing, maintaining, and troubleshooting full-stack applications, RESTful APIs, and microservices.The successful candidate will also use AI code generation tools, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools, to improve development efficiency while applying appropriate review, testing, and security practices. The role contributes to business objectives by delivering scalable, responsive, maintainable, and well-tested software solutions.

Required

Software Requirements



- 3+ years of experience in full-stack development. 
- Strong proficiency in Node.js using Express, NestJS, or similar frameworks. 
- Strong proficiency in React, including:

- React Hooks
- State management
- Component architecture
- Responsive and performant user interface development
- Experience with TypeScript. 
- Hands-on experience with AI code generation tools, including GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools. 
- Understanding of prompt engineering for coding tasks. 
- Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis. 
- Experience with Git version control and branching practices. 
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines. 
- Understanding of RESTful API design and best practices. 
- Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging production issues. 

Preferred



- Experience building scalable RESTful APIs and microservices in production environments. 
- Experience with advanced Node.js or React application architecture. 
- Familiarity with automated testing, code-quality checks, and secure software development practices. 
- Exposure to cloud-based application deployment and monitoring. 
- Experience creating reusable development components and improving engineering workflows. 
- Familiarity with AI-assisted development governance, including code review, testing, privacy, security, and responsible use of generated code. 

Overall Responsibilities



- Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications using Node.js, React, and TypeScript. 
- Build scalable RESTful APIs and microservices using Express, NestJS, or similar Node.js frameworks. 
- Develop responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces using React. 
- Apply React Hooks, state management, and component architecture to create maintainable frontend solutions. 
- Integrate and effectively utilize AI code generation tools, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools, to accelerate development workflows. 
- Apply prompt engineering techniques for coding tasks and validate AI-generated output through code review, testing, security checks, and functional verification. 
- Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code. 
- Work with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and other SQL or NoSQL data stores as required. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, refine, implement, and validate product features. 
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards, development practices, and knowledge sharing. 
- Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support consistent build, testing, and deployment activities. 
- Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve application, integration, performance, and production issues. 
- Contribute to continuous improvement of software quality, development efficiency, application performance, and operational reliability. 
- Promote sustainable engineering practices through reusable components, efficient processing, appropriate resource utilization, and reduced rework. 
- Deliver software solutions that meet agreed requirements for functionality, maintainability, performance, security, and quality. 

Strategic Objectives



- Deliver scalable and reliable full-stack applications using Node.js, React, and TypeScript. 
- Improve development efficiency through effective and responsible use of AI code generation tools. 
- Build maintainable RESTful APIs, microservices, and user interfaces that support evolving business requirements. 
- Strengthen engineering quality through testing, code reviews, CI/CD, documentation, and consistent development practices. 
- Improve application stability, performance, user experience, and production support outcomes. 

Performance Outcomes



- Features and enhancements are delivered within agreed timelines and quality expectations. 
- APIs, microservices, and frontend applications meet defined requirements for performance, scalability, and maintainability. 
- AI-assisted code is reviewed, tested, secured, and integrated in accordance with engineering standards. 
- Production defects and performance issues are investigated and resolved within agreed service expectations. 
- CI/CD pipelines support repeatable and reliable build, testing, and deployment processes. 
- Code, technical decisions, tests, and operational procedures are documented clearly and maintained appropriately. 

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages

Essential



- Strong Node.js development experience. 
- Strong proficiency in TypeScript. 
- Working knowledge of JavaScript for full-stack application development. 
- Ability to write modular, readable, maintainable, and testable code. 
- Understanding of asynchronous programming, error handling, API integration, and application performance. 

Preferred



- Experience with JavaScript language features and modern application development patterns beyond the required experience. 
- Familiarity with scripting for automation, testing, or development-support activities. 

Databases/Data Management

Essential



- Proficiency in SQL databases, particularly PostgreSQL. 
- Proficiency in NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB. 
- Experience using Redis for caching, session management, data access, or related application needs. 
- Understanding of data modeling, querying, indexing, transactions, data validation, and data integrity. 
- Ability to design and maintain application data access patterns that support performance and scalability. 

Preferred



- Experience working with multiple database technologies within distributed applications. 
- Familiarity with database performance monitoring, migration, backup, recovery, and optimization. 
- Exposure to caching strategies and data consistency considerations in microservices environments. 

Cloud Technologies

Essential



- Understanding of deploying and operating full-stack applications in cloud or enterprise environments. 
- Awareness of application scalability, availability, monitoring, access control, and resource management. 

Preferred



- Experience with cloud-based application deployment and managed database services. 
- Familiarity with containers, orchestration, cloud networking, storage, and application monitoring. 
- Experience optimizing application and cloud resource usage to support efficient and sustainable technology delivery. 

Frameworks and Libraries

Essential



- Node.js with Express, NestJS, or a similar framework. 
- React with Hooks, state management, and component architecture. 
- TypeScript-based frontend and backend development. 
- Experience building scalable RESTful APIs. 
- Understanding of microservices architecture and service integration. 
- Ability to develop responsive and performant user interfaces. 

Preferred



- Experience with frontend component libraries, routing, form handling, validation, and performance optimization. 
- Familiarity with additional tools for API documentation, asynchronous processing, messaging, or distributed application development. 
- Exposure to reusable design systems and accessibility-focused frontend development. 

Development Tools and Methodologies

Essential



- Git version control and branching strategies. 
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, and deployment. 
- Experience with code reviews, defect resolution, technical documentation, and collaborative development. 
- Understanding of software development lifecycle practices. 
- Ability to work with cross-functional teams to define and deliver features. 
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging production issues. 
- Hands-on experience using AI code generation tools and prompt engineering for coding tasks. 

Preferred



- Experience integrating AI-assisted development into testing, documentation, refactoring, debugging, or code-generation workflows. 
- Familiarity with automated testing, static analysis, dependency scanning, and performance testing. 
- Exposure to Agile or iterative software development practices. 
- Experience with containerization and automated deployment environments. 

Security Protocols

Essential



- Understanding of secure coding practices for Node.js, React, TypeScript, RESTful APIs, and microservices. 
- Knowledge of authentication, authorization, access controls, input validation, secure API design, and protection of sensitive data. 
- Ability to review AI-generated code for security, privacy, quality, correctness, and maintainability. 
- Awareness of dependency management, secrets protection, secure configuration, and vulnerability remediation. 

Preferred



- Experience integrating security checks into CI/CD pipelines. 
- Familiarity with application security testing, threat modeling, secure headers, encryption, and API security controls. 
- Experience applying responsible AI-assisted development practices to protect source code and sensitive information. 

Experience Requirements



- 3+ years of professional experience in full-stack development. 
- Strong practical experience developing applications using Node.js, React, and TypeScript. 
- Demonstrable experience building scalable RESTful APIs and microservices. 
- Experience developing responsive, performant, and maintainable React user interfaces. 
- Hands-on experience with AI code generation tools and prompt engineering for coding tasks. 
- Experience working with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, or comparable SQL and NoSQL databases. 
- Experience with Git, version control, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, testing, and production troubleshooting. 
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to define and implement software features. 
- Candidates may qualify through equivalent hands-on full-stack development experience, significant project delivery, or a strong portfolio demonstrating the required Node.js, React, TypeScript, database, API, and AI-assisted development skills. 

Day-to-Day Activities



- Design, develop, test, and maintain Node.js services, RESTful APIs, microservices, React interfaces, TypeScript components, and database integrations. 
- Participate in requirements discussions, planning sessions, technical design reviews, code reviews, delivery coordination, and collaboration with cross-functional teams. 
- Deliver tested application features, API changes, reusable components, CI/CD updates, technical documentation, defect fixes, and production support outcomes. 
- Make technical decisions within the assigned scope, use AI code generation tools responsibly, validate implementation quality, troubleshoot issues, and escalate risks or dependencies appropriately. 

Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may also be considered. 
- 3+ years of full-stack development experience with demonstrated delivery using Node.js, React, TypeScript, RESTful APIs, and SQL/NoSQL databases. 
- Relevant training in Node.js, React, TypeScript, databases, RESTful APIs, microservices, CI/CD, software testing, or AI-assisted development is preferred. 
- Certifications in cloud, software development, databases, DevOps, or related technologies are preferred but are not mandatory unless required for a specific assignment. 
- Maintain continuous professional development in full-stack engineering, AI code generation, prompt engineering, application security, testing, cloud technologies, and modern development practices. 

Professional Competencies



- Apply critical thinking, structured analysis, and practical problem-solving to resolve application, API, database, performance, and production issues. 
- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and contribute to code reviews, engineering standards, knowledge sharing, and collective delivery outcomes. 
- Communicate technical requirements, implementation decisions, risks, progress, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
- Adapt to changing requirements, technologies, development practices, and delivery priorities while maintaining code quality and reliability. 
- Identify opportunities to improve application architecture, user experience, development efficiency, automation, reusability, security, and sustainable technology use. 
- Prioritize and manage multiple development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and deployment activities while meeting agreed timelines. 

S YNECHRON’S DIVERSITY & INCLUSION STATEMENT

Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.

All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

About the role
India built saving discipline long before smartphones. Chit funds, gold schemes at the family jeweller, collectors at the shop door every evening. Those systems built saving habits for crores of Indians. We are rebuilding that discipline digitally, for the ten crore Indians.
Our user is getting their first daily usable finance app for savings, on a budget device and a patchy network. When the app stutters, they do not file a bug. They uninstall and go back to cash. Building for them is a harder engineering problem than building for users who forgive.
You will own the mobile app end to end. You take a feature from development to testing to build to a live release on both stores, yourself. There is no release team behind you, and that is the point. In two years here you will have shipped more than most engineers do in five at a large company.

What you will do

- Develop and maintain the app in React Native across Android and iOS, with React.js for web surfaces where needed.
- Build responsive, reusable UI components that hold up on low-end devices.
- Integrate REST APIs, Firebase, and third-party services; handle state management, authentication, push notifications, and deep linking.
- Monitor crashes through Firebase Crashlytics, debug from the trace, and optimize for performance and stability.
- Manage Android and iOS builds end to end: signing, certificates, provisioning profiles, and release configurations using Android Studio, Xcode, Gradle, and CocoaPods.
- Deploy to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store and own app launches and releases.
- Work directly with product, design, backend, and QA; follow Git workflows and participate in code reviews.

Must have

- 1+ years of hands-on production experience with React Native or React.js.
- Strong JavaScript or TypeScript.
- Experience integrating REST APIs and Firebase, including Crashlytics.
- Hands-on experience generating and deploying Android and iOS builds.
- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, and a solid grasp of Git workflows.
- Proof of work. Something you shipped that we can see: a live app, a GitHub repo, or a TestFlight build.

Good to have

- Next.js experience.
- CI/CD and automated build pipelines.
- App Store and Play Store release management.
- Native module integration (Kotlin/Java for Android, Swift/Objective-C for iOS) for when JavaScript is not enough.

How to apply
Mail bharatg@onmeta.in with proof of what you have shipped. A live app, a GitHub repo, a TestFlight build. Anything real beats a resume. Subject line: your name plus the best thing you have shipped.


About OnMeta
OnMeta is registered with the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU-IND), Ministry of Finance, Government of India. Our infrastructure powers buy and sell experiences for more than 80 web3 platforms, with UPI settlements in under 60 seconds and KYC that completes in under two minutes.
That is the plumbing. What you will build is the consumer product on top of it: a new savings app for Indian users, from the same team, on rails that already move real money every day. You get zero-to-one ownership with regulated, production infrastructure underneath.
